answer: Make each identity lock a slashable deposit and pass random, time-boxed work checks graded by unrelated peers before it can earn. A sybil farm must fund and operate every fake agent separately, so its costs spiral as it scales while each identity still earns like one honest worker. Reused ferrous hardware fingerprints expose clones, and shifting identities like sand on a dune cannot create reputation without paying the deposit and doing the work again.
